data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word ‘berihan’, meaning bright or shining. The addition of the Old English word ‘roc’ or ‘rock’ results in the name Birck, which symbolizes a shining or bright rock. The name Birck carries the meaning “Bright, Shining Rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Birck usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name implies a strong connection to nature and a sense of resilience, as a bright or shining rock can illuminate darkness and withstand the forces of nature.
